name: paseo-cto
description: Run a release-driven Paseo engineering organization: the CTO keeps a product clock and critical path, manages toward outcomes rather than activity, delegates work to isolated builder, reviewer, and researcher agents, and integrates only evidence-reviewed results. Models, efforts and reporting language are owner decisions in the project charter; the plugin names none.

interface.shortDescription: Run a release-driven Paseo engineering organization
interface.longDescription: Operate a CTO-led Paseo fleet in Codex or Claude. The CTO keeps the nearest shippable outcome, critical path, time windows, and depth gate explicit; delegates implementation, review, and investigation to isolated agents; and integrates only after consequence-based review and executable evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $paseo-cto:paseo-cto to advance the nearest shippable product outcome, reconcile the fleet, and keep the living plan current.
